# Demystifying HyperFrames: The Framework Transforming HTML to Video for AI Agents!

HyperFrames is an open source framework that transforms HTML, CSS and animations into MP4 video, always with the same result for the same code. The video shows what you can build, the anatomy of a project, why the format serves AI agents and how it compares to Removal.

Video by Maurício Yokoyama Issei, published on August 22, 2026 (8 min 26 s).
Watch: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5HaAVA4316Q

_The video and the transcript are in Portuguese. The minutes between brackets, such as [04:12], point to the excerpt of the video._

## The idea: programming a video as a site is programmed

The video proposes programming a video in the same way as building a site, without editing time line and without heavy manual rendering [00:00]. The tool for this is HyperFrames, which uses HTML along with AI to generate video by programming [00:43].

## What HyperFrames Is

HyperFrames is an open source framework. It takes HTML, CSS, media files and animations and generates deterministic MP4 videos [01:24].

Underneath, it uses Chrome in headless mode, without graphical interface, along with FFmpeg, to capture frames in sync [01:45]. Deterministic means that the same code entry always generates the same video, today or 10 years from now [02:06].

The GitHub documentation summarizes the idea in a sentence: "write HTML, render video, made for agents" [02:06]. No need to learn a proprietary format or an editing interface [02:28].

## What you can build

- Product release films in 4K [02:49].
- Explanatory videos without presenter, with visual, text and typography generated by programming [02:49].
- A GitHub pull request transformed into a feature presentation video, with narration [03:10].
- Recordings of people talking to the camera, with overlapping graphics, data and citations [03:10].
- Interactive presentations and music videos with cuts in the rhythm of music [03:30].

## The anatomy of a project

The folder structure follows the organization of a web project [03:30]. The `index.html` is the main composition of the video. The `assets` folder stores images, videos, audios and fonts, and the `compositions` folder stores reusable scenes [03:51].

The `frame.md` file translates web design rules, such as identity and scale, to specifications that work on video [04:11].

Time also becomes HTML. Attributes like `data-start` and `data-duration` say when an element enters and leaves the scene [04:32]. For example: in the second 0 begins the background video; in the second 1 the title enters with a GSAP animation; in the second 6 the two end [04:32]. Everything can be seen in the browser before rendering [04:54].

## Made for AI agents

The flow with an agent has three steps [05:14]:

- Install about 20 HyperFrames skills by command line [05:14].
- Write a prompt with art direction and content [05:36].
- Leave the agent, like Claude Code or Cursor, plan the script and rhythm, write HTML, adjust the animations and render MP4 [05:36].

Language templates already write well HTML and CSS. When the video turns Simple HTML, they can edit video without learning a new tool [05:57].

## HyperFrames or Removal

Removal uses React components. So it requires a bundler and generates JSX files, and uses the Available Source Removal License [06:39]. HyperFrames uses HTML, CSS and controllable animations with Apache 2.0 Open Source License [06:59].

The biggest difference is that HyperFrames has no build step: a `index.html` already runs [07:19]. This facilitates the work of AI and reduces syntax and dependency errors [07:19].

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does the same code always generate the same video?

Yeah. HyperFrames is deterministic: the same input generates exactly the same video [02:06].

### Do I need to compile the project before I render it?

Nope. Unlike Removal, HyperFrames has no build step [07:19].

## About the video

In this video, we do a complete immersion in HyperFrames, an innovative open source framework under the Apache 2.0 license.
, developed by HeyGen's team.
If you are an artificial intelligence developer, designer or enthusiast, find out how this tool allows you to use traditional web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and seekable (controllable) animations to render MP4 videos fully deterministically. This means that the same code will generate exactly the same video, frame by frame, in any execution!
In addition, understand why HyperFrames is the perfect environment for autonomous AI agents (such as Claude Code, Cursor and others) to generate and edit video content directly via code.
What you will learn in this video:
What is HyperFrames and what is its purpose.
The project architecture: like CLI, SDK, Player, Studio UI and rendering engines connect.
How does the structure of a project work: the role of files such as index.html, frame.md, STORYBOARD.md and the composition model.
Practical demonstration: how to set times with date-* attributes and create high-level animations with GSAP.
Library and Components: knowing the vast library of ready blocks (such as transitions from shaders, graphics and special effects).
